findings.summary: Step 10 never writes finalSummary into the task file; it only patches status and moves the file. So the two prettier tests, default and useAtomicCompletion=true, already pass on main. They guard against a regression on the Step 10 commit path but do not show the fix working. That matches AC #3, but a one-line comment in the test would stop a reader thinking it reproduces the bug.

findings.summary: This change adds `prettier` ^3.10.1 to pipeline-cli as a devDependency. It is only imported by the two test files (`task-done.test.ts`, `10-finalize.test.ts`) and is never called from runtime code or either commit path, which matches AC #4. The lockfile pins it to 3.10.1. Because it is a well-known package used only in tests, this adds no meaningful supply-chain risk. One optional tidy-up: if the repo root already supplies prettier, its version range could be kept in step with that one.
